narr: A stationary frontal boundary draped over Northeast Pennsylvania triggered isolated, slow moving thunderstorms with heavy rain during the early to mid-afternoon. These storms drifted over highly urbanized areas and produced excessive rainfall and minor street and poor drainage flooding.
ev: Road closed due to high water near Mulberry and Prescott Ave.
Street flooding was reported on S Blakely Street.
